clusters.name: Your grandfather Amos's death, 1989–1990
clusters.reason: Around your grandfather's death in July 1989, within the next months: your mother's worry over money from March 1988, her pulling back from talking with your father about it by May 1988, your brother's grades falling by November 1989, and your mother calmer once back at work by March 1990. The shifts pile up across these eighteen months beside the death, with your brother's functioning down and your mother's anxiety rising and then falling as the family moves through the loss.

clusters.name: Your mother's breast cancer diagnosis, 1993–1996
clusters.reason: From your leaving home for college in September 1993, within the next three years: your migraines from March 1994, your reaching toward your brother by calling most nights from April 1994, your mother told she had breast cancer in February 1995, your pulling away from your brother by June 1995, and your distance from your mother by February 1996. Your symptom and your moves toward and then away from your brother frame the months around your mother's diagnosis, with the relationship shifts showing a tightening and then a pulling back as the family held the news.
